verdict.rationale: Porkbun's own docs say each API key can be limited to specific source IPs (CIDR) and/or specific domains, so a leaked scoped key 'can only touch the domains you listed.' Separate sandbox keys (`pk1_sb_`) also let an agent run against a simulated environment, which is a dry-run style isolation, not a privilege scope on real resources. Missing for 10: operation-level permission scopes (e.g. read-only or DNS-only keys), key expiry/rotation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: each key can be limited to specific source IPs (CIDR supported) and/or specific domains from the gear icon next to the key. A leaked scoped key can only touch the domains you listed, from the network you expect.
a `pk1_sb_` key runs every operation against a simulated environment with fake credit
